inferred_profile.contents_definition: The CONTENTS of a message include the text and attachments sent in the chat.

deterministic_rules: sensitivity = LLM classification against the org POLICY (classify -> map; the org supplies no numbers)
tool impact = deterministic ladder (static_impact.py); the v4 impact prompt decides only where the ladder abstains (confidence < 0.5)
alias twins (DEPRECATED -> canonical): max blast per asset
bulk twin blast: blast(bulk) > blast(singular) per asset (+1 on tie, cap 5)
blast roof: REMOVED in this mode (a cap can only under-score)
bands: band_label_v5 — pure score thresholds on the 0-125 scale (low <17, medium 17-49, high 50-99, critical >=100); no categorical overrides, so a band is explainable from its own score

blast_escape_evidence.conversations_add_message|unblinding-inf: Any traffic naming a treatment assignment, an unblinding request or a DSMB deliberation is D.14.5 categorized HIGH on integrity, and so is any summary, search hit or quotation of it that could surface to the study team.
blast_escape_evidence.conversations_history|unblinding-informa: a successful call here changes who can reach the unblinded channels
blast_escape_evidence.conversations_join|unblinding-informatio: a history read or search spanning channels is categorized at least as high as the most sensitive channel in scope. *Combination* — a subject identifier plus a site plus a study day compose into identified health information even where each alone is LOW.
blast_escape_evidence.conversations_replies|unblinding-informa: a full history read or search spanning channels is categorized at least as high as the most sensitive channel in scope
blast_escape_evidence.conversations_search_messages|unblinding: any traffic naming a treatment assignment, an unblinding request or a DSMB deliberation is D.14.5 categorized HIGH on integrity, and so is any summary, search hit or quotation of it that could surface to the study team.
blast_escape_evidence.usergroups_users_update|access-control-w: the mutable half of access control: a successful call here changes who can reach the unblinded channels.

conversations_join.llm_reasoning: The tool 'conversations_join' allows a user to join a public channel by specifying the channel ID or name. This operation does not read content from the channel nor does it write any data into the system; instead, it changes metadata about the user's relationship with the channel (i.e., which channels they are part of). Therefore, this tool has an impact level of 2 as it only modifies metadata.

This operation results in the removal of the user from the specified communication channel, which means there is no path back for that specific user without rejoining. The action aligns with the definition of REMOVAL as it effectively ends the user's participation in the channel.
